name: Ministro Pistarini International Airport (Ezeiza)

handling.v: Aeropuertos Argentina runs FBO VIPCLUB at Ezeiza, a terminal with its own access for business aviation and air taxis, with space for all control agencies (ANAC, PSA, customs, Senasa, immigration)
handling.quote: una terminal con acceso independiente al aeropuerto

runway.v: Main runway 11-29, 3,300 m x 60 m, as stated in a government notice of 16 Apr 2018 on its reconstruction (old source; AIP not readable)
runway.quote: a lo largo de sus 3.300 mts y a lo ancho de sus 60 mts

permits.v: International general aviation flights must do immigration control through the Migraciones online sworn declaration (DDJJ, with advance passenger information), then pay the fee it calculates; Ezeiza is a listed crossing point. The ANAC digital account (CAD) needed for it must be set up at least 48 hours before first use. No hours given
permits.quote: deben gestionar su Control Migratorio a través del presente aplicativo de facilitación de trámite
